title: Meadow
about: A stochastic tree in 1,300 grass tufts grown in patches: two grammars, one scene, every tuft from its own seed.

title: Tree
about: Branches pitch out with &, roll with /, thin with !, and grow leaves at every node.

title: Grass field
about: 1,350 tufts in 36 patches from one grammar; recursive code keeps the IR the size of the grammar.

title: Grass tuft
about: One clump of blades; G draws a flat blade instead of a tube.

title: Shrub
about: A dense three-way branching bush with random internode lengths.

title: Wildflower (stochastic)
about: Stage 3: weighted rules and a seed. Change the seed for a new plant.

title: Tree
about: ABOP fig. 1.24d, one branch to each side per node.

title: Bush
about: Two side branches per node, then the stem grows on.

title: Weed
about: Every segment sprouts a left and a right twig.

title: Heighway dragon
about: X and Y draw nothing; they only steer the rewriting.

title: Sierpinski carpet
about: Lowercase f moves without drawing; that leaves the holes.

title: Sierpinski arrowhead
about: F and G both draw; alternating turns build the triangle.

title: Hilbert curve
about: A space-filling curve; A and B only steer.
